verdict.rationale: Copilot generates AI suggestions and insights directly from the user's code and repository data inside the product. This includes completions and next-edit suggestions, code review feedback with suggested changes and High/Medium/Low severity labels, Autofix vulnerability explanations, and knowledge grounded in the user's own docs and repos. Community users confirm that suggestions reflect their open code and context. Missing for 10: insights beyond code (e.g., analytics or trend-style insights on project or repository data) and in-depth independent corroboration of review and Autofix insight quality.
